result:
Gate A verdict:

```json
{
  "verdict": "ACCEPT_WITH_CHANGES",
  "mustFixBeforeP1": [
    "Tree-sitter must AUGMENT, not REPLACE, the existing regex JS/TS extraction (_JS_FUNCTION_RE/_JS_IMPORT_RE, derived_by='javascript_regex'). Existing javascript_module/function/import nodes and 'imports' edges must remain byte-identical, or node/edge IDs shift and the additive guarantee plus existing JS tests break.",
    "Thread `confidence` through the _edge() helper for new calls/inherits edges and guarantee id uniqueness: edge id currently hashes only kind|from|to|label and excludes confidence/derived_by, so same-target edges differing only in confidence collide. Fold confidence/derived_by into the id hash for the new kinds only, or always emit a distinguishing label.",
    "Cross-file call/inheritance resolution must be order-independent and deterministic: build the node/symbol table first, resolve targets in a later pass (mirror the existing two-pass 'tests' edge handling at lines 517-535), and keep the final sort-by-id. Extend the determinism characterization test to cover the calls/inherits paths.",
    "Coverage gate is fail_under=100. Every new branch in project_graph.py (resolved vs unresolved call target, single vs multiple base classes, parse-failure paths) must be exercised by tests in the P1 PR or CI fails."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "P0 verified as pinning/harness-only: pyproject + uv.lock add tree-sitter==0.25.2 / -javascript==0.25.0 / -typescript==0.23.2; the sole test is a determinism characterization of existing behavior; project_graph.py is unchanged.",
    "Additive-safety holds structurally: edges are dict-keyed by hashed id then sorted; kind is a free str; all graph tests assert subsets (<=), not equality.",
    "GraphEdge.confidence and ProvenanceRef.confidence are already plain str defaulting to 'deterministic' — the new vocabulary needs no schema or type change.",
    "Consumer tolerance is taken from excerpts only (decomposer_ai filters to imports/tests; meta_decomposer acts only on imports; snapshot-gate test already carries a 'calls' edge). Full consumer files were not independently re-read in this gate.",
    "reportMissingTypeStubs=false is already set, so importing the untyped tree-sitter packages will not regress pyright.",
    "Consider whether adding calls/inherits warrants bumping schema_version from 'project-graph/v0.1' — not type churn, but a versioning decision for downstream snapshot/gate consumers."
  ],
  "gateBDesignQuestions": [
    "Scope: is P1 JS/TS-only (the pinned grammars), or also Python? Python calls/inherits would naturally come from the existing `ast` path (ClassDef.bases for inherits, ast.Call for calls), not tree-sitter — confirm intended source per language.",
    "Unresolved targets: when a call or base class can't resolve to an in-graph node (external/dynamic), do we mint an import-like placeholder node (as python_import does) with confidence='ambiguous', or skip the edge?",
    "Confidence mapping: define precisely which outcomes are deterministic vs heuristic vs ambiguous (e.g. same-file resolved = deterministic, cross-file name-matched = heuristic, multiple candidate targets = ambiguous).",
    "Node endpoints: which kinds do calls edges connect (function->function only, or also ->import)? Do inherits edges connect class->class and class->import for external bases?",
    "Should downstream consumers (snapshot gate contracts, intake scorecard) opt in to calls/inherits as a separate explicitly-gated change, keeping this PR purely additive to the builder?"
  ]
}
```

**Bottom line:** The handoff plan is additive-safe in principle and P0 is genuinely pinning/harness-only with no extraction change. Verdict is ACCEPT_WITH_CHANGES rather than ACCEPT because the additivity guarantee depends on P1 honoring concrete constraints — chiefly not perturbing the existing regex JS extraction, preserving edge-id determinism when confidence is introduced, and meeting the 100% coverage gate.
